nx_a4_mc_001: Social-media questions have one axis: could a reader identify the client? Details like unit, condition and timeframe identify even without a name, so the required action is reporting the breach, not judging intent.
nx_a4_mc_002: Telephone orders demand read-back: write it, read it back, get confirmation, and secure the countersignature within policy time. Any option skipping read-back fails regardless of what else it includes.
nx_a4_mc_003: The time-out happens immediately before incision with the whole team, verifying right client, right procedure, right site. Options placing it in pre-op holding or making it one person's job are the distractors.
nx_a4_mc_004: Life-threatening emergency plus no capacity plus no surrogate equals implied consent: treat now. Options that delay for consent paperwork mistake the legal doctrine being tested.
nx_a4_mc_005: When client and family disagree, the capacitated client's voice controls: the nursing role is advocacy - facilitate communication and support the client's stated goals, never mediate toward the family's preference.
nx_a4_mc_006: Discharge planning begins at admission - for elective surgery, effectively at the preoperative visit. Any option that starts planning after a milestone (surgery done, orders written) is late by design.
nx_a4_mc_007: Handoff questions reward structured, interactive communication: a standardized format with the chance to ask questions. Options describing one-way notes or verbal fragments fail the safety standard.
nx_a4_mc_008: A capacitated refusal is honoured, documented, and reported to the provider - the trio appears together. Options that hide the dose in food or simply chart 'refused' without follow-through are both wrong.
nx_a4_pa_001: Post-pelvic-surgery sudden dyspnea with pleuritic pain is pulmonary embolism until proven otherwise: the sequence is oxygen, position, rapid notification. Deprioritise anything that walks the client or waits.
nx_a4_pa_002: Fever, tachycardia and agitation after thyroidectomy in Graves' disease is thyroid storm - a rapid-response emergency, not a fever to treat with acetaminophen and reassessment.
nx_a4_pa_003: Melena plus orthostatic lightheadedness is active GI bleeding with volume loss: priorities are vitals including orthostatics, access and rapid reporting - the circulation problem outranks the stool test.
nx_a4_pa_004: Burn resuscitation adequacy is read at the kidney: urine output in the target range is THE endpoint. Options citing thirst, pressure alone, or weight miss what the fluids are titrated to.
nx_a4_pa_005: Rib fracture plus sudden dyspnea, absent sounds one side, tracheal shift equals tension pneumothorax: prepare for immediate decompression. Any option that orders a confirmatory X-ray first spends time the client lacks.
nx_a4_pa_006: Appendicitis pain that suddenly stops then returns as rigid-abdomen fever is rupture with peritonitis - escalate now. The trap is reading pain relief as improvement.
nx_a4_si_001: Newborn security SATA: match banded identifiers at every handoff, transport in bassinets, release only to banded staff, and question anyone carrying an infant in arms - accept options enforcing those, reject convenience exceptions.
nx_a4_si_002: MRI preparation is a metal hunt: screen for implants, remove all metal including patches with foil backings, and verify pump/line compatibility. Any option letting metal into the room fails.
nx_a4_si_003: Banana-kiwi-avocado reactions cross-react with latex: the assessment finding demands latex precautions and allergy-band documentation before any equipment touches the client.
nx_a4_si_004: Chemical eye splash means flush first - copious water or saline immediately, minutes matter - then report per the exposure protocol. Options that seek the SDS or occupational health before irrigating reverse the order.
nx_a4_si_005: A dependent transfer is an equipment question: friction-reducing devices or a lift with adequate staff. Options relying on manual lifting by two strong staff are the injury the policy exists to prevent.
nx_a4_rr_001: Cast SATA teaching: elevate, ice per protocol, report pain-numbness-pallor, never insert objects, keep it dry. Screen each option against circulation protection and skin integrity.
nx_a4_rr_002: A positional headache after lumbar puncture - worse upright, better flat - is a post-dural-puncture headache: flat positioning, fluids, caffeine per protocol, and notification if severe. The positional clue is the answer's fingerprint.
nx_a4_rr_003: After femoral catheterization the leg stays straight and the site gets scheduled checks of dressing AND distal pulses - the paired assessment is the correct option's signature.
nx_a4_rr_004: Sudden dyspnea with an open central line is air embolism: clamp, left side, head down, oxygen, call. The positioning (Durant) options separate prepared test-takers from guessers.
nx_a4_rr_005: Daily warfarin disclosed a week before elective surgery must be reported to the surgical team now - anticoagulation management needs lead time; noting it in the record for surgery day is the trap.
nx_a5_mc_001: Incident reports are internal quality tools: complete the report, document the clinical facts in the chart, but never chart that a report was filed - the option referencing the report in the record is the planted error.
nx_a5_mc_002: Medication reconciliation at transfer exists to catch discrepancies as lists change hands - the 'why' is continuity and omission-prevention, not billing or convenience distractors.
nx_a5_si_001: Unknown-quantity ingestion in a toddler is a poison-control call with the child observed - not induced vomiting, not watchful waiting at home. Acetaminophen's silent early phase is why 'he seems fine' is the trap.
nx_a5_si_002: Elopement risk in dementia is managed with supervision, redirection and environmental controls - least restrictive first; options reaching for restraints or sedation skip the required ladder.
nx_a5_hp_001: Safe-sleep SATA: back to sleep, firm bare surface, room-sharing without bed-sharing, no overheating. Anything soft in the crib - bumpers, blankets, toys - is an automatic reject.
nx_a5_hp_002: Adolescent visits include confidential one-on-one time: interview the teen alone for part of the visit with confidentiality explained. Options keeping the parent present throughout miss the developmental standard.
nx_a5_ps_001: Two weeks of tearfulness, sleep loss and feeling unable to cope is beyond baby blues (which peak and resolve within about two weeks): screen for postpartum depression and assess safety - options that normalise it delay care.
nx_a5_ps_002: In precontemplation, the therapeutic response is a nonjudgmental door-opener - acknowledge autonomy, offer information for later. Lecture options fail motivational-interviewing principles by design.
nx_a5_bc_001: Colostomy teaching centres on the skin barrier: cut the wafer to fit closely, empty the pouch when a third full, and report peristomal skin breakdown. Options soaking or scrubbing the stoma miss that it is mucosa.
nx_a5_bc_002: Feeding independence for a blind client is orientation, not assistance: describe the tray by clock positions and place items consistently. Options that feed the client answer a different question.
nx_a5_ph_001: Mixing insulins is clear-before-cloudy: air into NPH, air into regular, draw regular first, then NPH. Any option drawing the cloudy insulin first contaminates the rapid vial.
nx_a5_ph_002: First dose of a new antibiotic: verify allergies before administration and monitor closely after - the allergy check is the step every distractor conveniently skips.
nx_a5_rr_001: Post-thyroidectomy bedside equipment answers to the two emergencies: airway obstruction (tracheostomy supplies) and hypocalcemia from parathyroid injury (calcium gluconate) - the pairing is the correct option.
nx_a5_rr_002: No void eight hours post-op with suprapubic discomfort: assess first - bladder scan - then intervene by protocol. Options that catheterise before scanning skip the assessment step NCLEX rewards.
nx_a5_pa_001: Drowsiness plus confusion in cirrhosis is hepatic encephalopathy; the bedside confirmation is asterixis - the flapping tremor on wrist extension - so the assessment option naming it wins.
nx_a5_pa_002: New confusion in an octogenarian with a UTI IS the septic red flag: altered mentation plus hypothermia-range or rising temperature means sepsis screening now, not reorientation and recheck later.
